An unknown series of [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] that was in service on several planets throughout the galaxy. On the mining colony of [[Tyne's Horky]] an orange and red colored unit was being sold at auction outside of [[Doodnik's Café]], and a purple and gray colored unit was present on [[Biitu]] as part of the [[Great Heep]]'s [[Droid harem]].

==Behind the scenes==
The head shape of these droids appears to be somewhat similar to that of the [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4-series agromech droid]], but this model has more of a neck and appears to be taller.
